title: [spec-gap][R-02-009] C radio never returns to CH0 after a data-channel TX; Python TX channel field dropped (spec 02 3.3)
description: Req R-02-009 (spec/02-physical-link.md 3.3 channel plan): CH0 is control; ALL NODES MUST LISTEN WHEN IDLE. DIVERGENT/LATENT: C init RX on CH0 (lora_l2.c:183 rx_channel=0, :298-300 frequency), but lora_l2_tx.c:379-408 reconfigures the radio to base + ch*200kHz for a data-channel TX and lora_l2_rx_arm() (lora_l2_rx.c:175-216) re-arms RX WITHOUT restoring CH0 frequency — after a data-channel TX the node idles on the data channel, violating the MUST. Currently latent: every C TX call site passes channel 0 (lichen_l2_tx.c:192,195). Python: tx_queue entries carry a channel field (tx_queue.py:198,356,413) but link_layer.py:1480 transmits entry.data only — channel never reaches the radio (sim idle default CH0 at sim/node.py:57). Related: rendezvous TX bead (pinned rx_channel never used for unicast TX). Suggested placement: C lora_l2_rx_arm/lora_l2_tx restore-to-CH0 after TX; python link_layer channel propagation.
